details: The cryptocurrency market saw a significant rally on Thursday, August 20, 2026, driven by two key developments. The U.S. Treasury announced an unexpected increase in its buyback operations for long-dated bonds, aiming to inject liquidity into the market. This move led to a sharp reversal in global bond yields and weakened the dollar, creating a favorable "risk-on" environment for assets like Bitcoin and Ethereum. Simultaneously, former US President Donald Trump expressed strong support for the crypto sector, urging Congress to pass supportive legislation. These factors combined to push Bitcoin above $71,000 and Ether above $2,250, with analysts predicting further upside, potentially reaching $100,000 for Bitcoin by year-end.
title: US Treasury Boosts Bond Buybacks, Trump Backs Crypto, Sparking Rally
